title: Selective acetylene hydrogenation reference family
reaction: C2H2 + H2 -> C2H4 (selective) | over-hydrogenation: C2H2 + 2 H2 -> C2H6 (avoided)
objective: Optional literature-backed family for front-end / tail-end selective hydrogenation of acetylene impurity in ethylene streams. Candidates compare a Pd / alumina baseline (industrial), a Pd-Ag bimetallic anchor (Studt 2008 design rule, dominant front-end), and a Pd-Cu single-atom-alloy emerging route.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance catalyst cost, evidence quality, route maturity, and reported ethylene selectivity / over-hydrogenation suppression.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward catalyst cost while preserving route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward stronger literature support and more reproducible Pd-based selectivity-engineering routes.

citations.label: Appl. Catal. A 2007
citations.note: Huang, Pyrz et al.: selective hydrogenation of acetylene in the presence of ethylene on K+/beta-zeolite-supported Pd and Pd-Ag, demonstrating support and Ag-promotion effects on selectivity.

citations.label: Science 2008
citations.note: Studt, Abild-Pedersen et al.: identification of non-precious-metal alloy catalysts for selective hydrogenation of acetylene; foundational descriptor-based design (1100+ citations) underpinning the Pd-Ag and Cu-based selectivity-engineering literature.

citations.label: Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 2013
citations.note: Boucher, Zugic et al.: single-atom-alloy surface analogs in Pd-Cu nanoparticles for selective hydrogenation, foundational SAA paper applied to acetylene-style hydrogenation.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2015
citations.note: Lucci, Liu et al.: selective hydrogenation of 1,3-butadiene on Pt-Cu alloys at the single-atom limit; landmark SAA selectivity demonstration that generalises to acetylene hydrogenation.

citations.label: ACS Catal. 2017
citations.note: Kruppe, Krooswyk et al.: selective hydrogenation of acetylene to ethylene over a Pd/Cu(111) single-atom-alloy with a carbonaceous overlayer, model-surface validation of the SAA design.

citations.label: Catal. Sci. Technol. 2017
citations.note: Liu, Shan et al.: Pd-Au single-atom-alloy catalysts for liquid-phase selective hydrogenation of 1-hexyne, supporting the SAA design beyond Pd-Cu.

citations.label: J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2019
citations.note: Jorgensen, Gronbeck: selective acetylene hydrogenation over single-atom-alloy nanoparticles by kinetic Monte Carlo, providing first-principles-grounded selectivity predictions.

citations.label: Science 2008
citations.note: DFT screening discovers, and experiment confirms, Ni-Zn alloys matching Pd-Ag selectivity for acetylene hydrogenation with abundant metals.

citations.label: J. Catal. 2014
citations.note: Zinc inclusion into Ni suppresses green-oil oligomerization during acetylene semi-hydrogenation.

route_templates.name: Pd / Al2O3 baseline route
route_templates.route_note: Most transferable selective-hydrogenation basis; matches industrial low-loading Pd / Al2O3 catalysts widely used in front-end and tail-end units.

route_templates.name: Pd-Ag bimetallic route
synthesis: Sequential or co-impregnation of Pd and Ag
route_templates.route_note: Industrial front-end-style Pd-Ag selective hydrogenation route; Ag promoter widens the ethylene-selectivity window over the bare Pd baseline.

route_templates.name: Pd-Cu single-atom-alloy route
preprocess: Pd precursor balancing for sub-monolayer addition
route_templates.route_note: Pd-Cu single-atom-alloy emerging route; sub-monolayer Pd discipline keeps Pd intensity ultra-low at the cost of route maturity.

candidates.title: Pd / Al2O3 baseline
candidates.summary: Low-loading Pd on alumina, the canonical front-end / tail-end selective hydrogenation baseline; used as the cost and process anchor.
decision_notes: Most transferable selective-hydrogenation basis with mature commercial inputs.
Without a promoter, the ethylene-selectivity window is narrow and over-hydrogenation risk is higher than Pd-Ag.

pricing.note: Live Pd feed with a precursor / conversion markup; very low loading typical of industrial selective-hydrogenation catalysts.

Gamma-alumina support cost held on an engineering proxy comparable to commercial alumina ranges. USGS MCS 2026 metallurgical alumina (2025e $590/t import value, ~$0.27/lb) is the public floor; catalyst-grade premium retained. UN Comtrade 2024: calcined alumina (HS 281820) averaged $0.60/kg with specialty flows to $3.64/kg; catalyst-carrier activated/gamma alumina marketplace offers run $800-1,700/t.

candidates.title: Pd-Ag bimetallic (front-end style)
candidates.summary: Pd-Ag bimetallic on alumina; the dominant industrial front-end selective hydrogenation catalyst owing to a wide ethylene-selectivity window.
decision_notes: Best fit for front-end ethylene-purification duty where the ethylene-selectivity window must stay wide.
Catalyst economics dominated by Pd; Ag is a small fraction by mass but widens the operability window meaningfully.

pricing.note: Live Pd feed with a precursor / conversion markup; matches industrial front-end Pd loading ranges.
Live Ag feed with a mild precursor / conversion markup.

Gamma-alumina support cost held on an engineering proxy comparable to commercial alumina ranges. USGS MCS 2026 metallurgical alumina (2025e $590/t import value, ~$0.27/lb) is the public floor; catalyst-grade premium retained. UN Comtrade 2024: calcined alumina (HS 281820) averaged $0.60/kg with specialty flows to $3.64/kg; catalyst-carrier activated/gamma alumina marketplace offers run $800-1,700/t.

candidates.title: Pd-Cu single-atom alloy
candidates.summary: Pd-Cu single-atom-alloy catalyst exploiting isolated Pd in a Cu host for high ethylene selectivity at ultra-low Pd intensity.
decision_notes: Best fit when Pd intensity must be minimised and high ethylene selectivity is the program goal.
Sub-monolayer Pd reproducibility is the main route-maturity risk; SAA preparation discipline lowers route confidence vs Pd-Ag.

pricing.note: Live Pd feed with a precursor / conversion markup; SAA loading is sub-monolayer, much lower than the Pd-Ag bimetallic baseline.
Live Cu feed with a precursor / conversion markup as the SAA host metal.

Gamma-alumina support cost held on an engineering proxy comparable to commercial alumina ranges. USGS MCS 2026 metallurgical alumina (2025e $590/t import value, ~$0.27/lb) is the public floor; catalyst-grade premium retained. UN Comtrade 2024: calcined alumina (HS 281820) averaged $0.60/kg with specialty flows to $3.64/kg; catalyst-carrier activated/gamma alumina marketplace offers run $800-1,700/t.

candidates.title: NiZn intermetallic (non-Pd)
candidates.summary: The computationally discovered nickel-zinc alloy that matches Pd-Ag selectivity for front-end acetylene removal using two abundant metals - the family's hedge against palladium prices.
decision_notes: Removes the palladium term entirely; commercial maturity, not chemistry, is what holds the score down.
Ni/Zn loadings are screening assumptions (15/5 wt%): the cited abstracts establish the alloy strategy without weight loadings.

pricing.note: Live Ni feed; loading is a screening assumption.
Live Zn feed (LME settlement via Westmetall, USGS MCS fallback) with a precursor / conversion markup; upgraded from the fixed USGS LME-average proxy.
2025 USGS alumina import value used as a bulk oxide support proxy.
